data.name: ish.auth.prompt
data.value: Open this link in Safari, sign in to Microsoft, then paste the authorization code (or the full redirect URL). Never enter your password here.

data.name: ish.auth.failed
data.value: Microsoft sign-in failed: {0}. Check network access, certificates, and the authorization code; then reconnect.

data.name: ish.protocol.packet_invalid
data.value: Invalid or oversized network packet. The iSH port limits packet buffers to 8 MiB; check the server protocol and compression settings.

data.name: ish.auth.cache_invalid
data.value: Invalid session cache entry. Sign in again to replace the cached credentials.

data.name: ish.protocol.configuration_finished
data.value: The configuration phase has finished. Further packets must be routed through the play state.

data.name: ish.protocol.configuration_policy
data.value: The server requested a resource pack, transfer or code of conduct. Interactive handling for this configuration request is not yet implemented in the 1.21.11 port.

data.name: ish.chat.not_joined
data.value: Wait for the server to finish joining before sending chat.

data.name: ish.chat.secure_required
data.value: This server requires signed chat. Chat signing is not yet implemented in the 1.21.11 port.

data.name: ish.chat.length
data.value: Chat messages must contain between 1 and 256 characters.

data.name: ish.console.scope
data.value: Experimental 1.21.11 console: chat and commands. Signed chat, world/inventory handling, bots and automatic reconnect are not yet available on this path.

data.name: ish.console.joined
data.value: Joined the 1.21.11 server. Type chat or server commands; /exit disconnects.
